features.title: Plugin manifest schema and validator
acceptance: plugin.schema.json defines valid plugin manifest structure
validate-plugins.mjs validates plugin.json against schema
validator reports clear errors for invalid manifests

features.title: Skill frontmatter schema and validator
acceptance: skill.schema.json defines valid skill frontmatter
validator parses and validates SKILL.md frontmatter
validates name constraint (lowercase, numbers, hyphens, matches folder)

features.title: CI workflow with pinned dependencies
acceptance: package.json with pinned ajv/ajv-formats
validate-plugins.yml runs on all plugin component changes
npm ci used for reproducible installs

features.title: Local plugin symlink resolution
acceptance: Plugin loader resolves symlinks in ~/.cursor/plugins/local/
Symlinked plugins load identically to copied plugins

features.title: MCP server config validator
acceptance: mcp.schema.json defines valid mcp.json structure
validator checks placeholder variables against declared variables

features.title: Plugin component path existence validator
acceptance: validate-plugins.mjs validates component paths (skills, agents, commands, hooks, mcpServers, logo, icon) exist
validator reports clear errors for missing or incorrect paths
all existing tests continue to pass

features.title: PR Review Canvas diff renderer fix
acceptance: Diff lines are parsed and numbered from original hunk headers before any filtering
Import line filtering is opt-in and shows a collapsed "N import lines hidden" row
Whitespace-only collapsing only applies when changed lines are identical after trimming leading/trailing whitespace
Whitespace-sensitive file types (Python, YAML, Makefile) are excluded from whitespace collapsing
